children: fell 13.66% intraday after UBS downgraded it to Sell from Neutral and cut its price target to $6 from $10, implying about 40% downside. Jon Windham cited an extended build timeline and the absence of firm customer commitments, with competitors already moving toward construction.

Windham estimates the market currently implies $124 million of 2028 EBITDA against his own forecast of $29 million, a difference of more than four times. He assumes only one project begins construction in 2028 and models roughly $700 million of cumulative cash burn from 2026 through 2028.

Windham projects revenue rising from $185 million in 2028 to $924 million in 2030, a 123% compound annual rate, with earnings negative throughout. UBS cautions that project delays, setbacks at RoPower, and limited progress with the Tennessee Valley Authority could push the numbers further apart. A five-year-plus build leaves NuScale behind rivals already breaking ground.

title: NuScale Stock Falls 14% as UBS Sees a $95 Million EBITDA Gap
